name: Blueprint
summary: Engineering drawing on navy: a gridded drafting sheet, white line art drawn on stroke by stroke, cyan dimension lines, mono labels in a title block. Footage plays full-bleed for the story beats; drawn props (label, price tag, receipt, rocket, cards, checklist, scale) carry the explainer beats.
lexicon: blueprint / technical drawing look (cyanotype navy, white line art)
dip to black, punch-in, push, zoom transition (per beat)
best_for: explainers that move from a story to a framework: how things are built, costs, decisions, processes
footage: full-bleed, any; drawn scenes need none (project.json beats "draw")
music: light pulse or ticking electronic, 95-115 BPM; drops out for the CTA
sfx: pen scratch on draw-ons, a stamp thud, one whoosh on the rocket lift
